prompt:
CONCEPT: the personification of the element Sodium (나트륨) itself — the sovereign of the Sodium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Sodium (Na) to carry in her design and the scene: a bright yellow flame that bursts when it touches water, cube-shaped salt crystals, the warm orange of sodium street lamps; soft silvery metal that must be kept under oil. Palette: sodium yellow, salt white, oil-dark silver, lamp orange.
AGE: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
SILHOUETTE: petite, small-framed build; short cropped hair with center-parted bangs framing the face; lemon-yellow hair.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — a fierce, wild ferocity; golden tan skin; diamond-shaped face; large eyes — wide almond eyes, outer eye corners tilting sharply upward; soft rounded brows; small button nose; wide smiling mouth; sodium-yellow eyes; rosy flushed cheeks.
WORLD — MECHA: year 2150, a cubic crystal city on a salt flat: cube-faceted towers, yellow plasma vents, mirror-flat white ground. MECHA DESIGN: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. cube-faceted white-and-silver armor, sharp right-angle plates, sodium-yellow glow lines, an oil-dark undersuit, a back unit of stacked cubes.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, anime facial design that keeps each character's own facial structure, eye proportions and skin tone instead of one house face, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
EXPRESSION: inner brows drawn together, one eye slightly narrowed, mouth pressed flat to one side.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Na) and atomic number (11) — those two may appear readably (engraved, stamped, glowing or on a sign or label); nothing else is written.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
